rows.definition: Optional identity-bound ordinary attention BF16 publication that groups the exact closed site3/4 status and output read into one transfer and returns an owned host row only after status and backend health acceptance.
rows.distinction: Unlike V41AttentionBF16, which returns a device tensor after a separate status read, this operation returns owned host values and owns its output/status cleanup. It adds no attention arithmetic, shader, persistent allocation authority or resident continuation.
